target_customer: Independent and local pharmacies, and the patients who order prescriptions from them
problem: Patients lose time waiting in pharmacy lines or picking up medication, and independent pharmacies lack the digital ordering and delivery tools that chains have.
business_model: B2B2C software and delivery service sold to pharmacies, with fees on fulfilled prescription orders
product_category: Pharmacy delivery and prescription management platform

founders.name: Talha Sattar
founders.background_notes: CNBC says he worked in finance and management consulting before the company and got the idea waiting in a pharmacy line for a family member's medication. Employers and schools not named in opened sources.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed a dispatch and delivery layer, pharmacy system integrations and patient ordering apps, which is standard engineering with regulated data handling.

defensibility.rationale: Pharmacy relationships and integrations create some lock in, but a delivery app wedge was copyable by chains and other startups.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: CNBC in 2017 noted CVS and Walgreens offered delivery through Postmates and Instacart, and Amazon was reported to be considering pharmacy. Nimble was bought by Swoop in 2026.

market_need_then: Patients wanted convenience and independent pharmacies faced pressure from chains; the founder describes the idea as coming from personal pharmacy wait times (CNBC 2017).

identity.logo: Wordmark with an N mark seen on directory listings
identity.voice_and_tone: Mission style language about convenience and healthier communities on the YC page

rebrands.why: Swoop said Nimble offerings will operate under this name after the acquisition (HLTH report)

brand_strength.rationale: Little press about the brand itself; the name is generic and shared with other companies called Nimble.

outcome_analysis: NimbleRx raised a Sequoia led $28 million round in 2017, grew a network of independent pharmacies and was acquired by Swoop in May 2026 with terms undisclosed. It focused on independent pharmacies against chain and Amazon pressure, which gave it a niche, and it ended in an acquisition rather than an independent exit.
notes: Directory status says Active though Swoop acquired Nimble in May 2026. Aggregators (Clay, CB Insights, Employbl, VCBacked) list a 2015 Series A of about 12M, a 20M round in 2018 and a 2022 round of about 14.7M to 25M with conflicting totals from 60M to 85M; all unverified single aggregator figures. CNBC does not label the 2017 round, so stage is other. Competitors named in 2017 coverage (NowRx, Alto Pharmacy) are dated two years after the batch so are not listed; no competitor source dated near Winter 2015 was found. Founding year is 2014 or 2015 by source.
